project.title: GoldenEye 007 Native PC Port
project.platform: Nintendo 64 → Windows x64, Linux x86-64, Steam Deck
project.status: v0.5.0 (2026-10-07) is a pre-1.0 release. The maintainer reports the campaign and 2–4 player split-screen playable end to end on Windows, Linux, and Steam Deck. Release packages accept the US NTSC-U ROM; the current project page says PAL/JP ROMs can be built from source, while macOS and ARM builds are not available yet.
project.summary: Native C source port built from the GoldenEye 007 decompilation, with a software RSP and a PC hardware-services layer. The user supplies the ROM; no ROM or bulk game assets are shipped.
project.strategy: Native C port compiled from the matching N64 decompilation; software RSP and native PC services, not binary recompilation or a full-system emulator
project.source_available: Public source and v0.5.0 releases. The project NOTICE says MIT covers the PC port layer, build system, PC-port tools, and docs; files inherited from the GoldenEye decompilation are outside that grant, and upstream n64decomp/007 has no explicit license. The user supplies a ROM; no ROM or bulk game assets are included.
